programme.title: A Christmas for the Ages
programme.desc: Prompted by their youngest granddaughter, four generations of women celebrate Christmas and family in the style of the 40s, 60s, 90s, and today.

programme.title: Christmas of Giving
programme.desc: Belle Carter has devoted her whole life to making the holidays bright for those in need. With Christmas approaching and the community's hopes hanging in the balance, she discovers believing in the best of people is the greatest gift of all.

programme.title: A Wisconsin Christmas Pie
programme.desc: A pastry chef returns to Wisconsin when she learns her family's farm is on the brink of being sold to developers. Reconnecting with her high school sweetheart, they discover love may just be the recipe for saving the farm -- and their hearts.

programme.title: A Cozy Christmas Quilt
programme.desc: A fireman and a quilting teacher team up to make a Christmas quilt for the former's sister's wedding. As they navigate their feelings for each other, they must decide what is truly important in time for the holiday season.

programme.title: Christmas Angel
programme.desc: Ashley gets a new job from her neighbor Nick as his assistant in the best work: being a Secret Santa. Nick has sworn her to secrecy, which includes her new friend Will, a reporter in search of a Christmas story for his magazine.

programme.title: Christmas on Candy Cane Lane
programme.desc: Ivy Donaldson struggles with her mom's shadow, Muriel, the Christmas darling of Icicle Falls. She is now separated from her husband Rob and tries her best with her daughter.

programme.title: Christmas Time Is Here
programme.desc: A small-town real estate agent desperately tries to convince her widowed father not to sell the family resort to a prospective buyer.

programme.title: I'm Glad It's Christmas
programme.desc: An aspiring Broadway singer is convinced to participate in a small-scale production for the local Christmas celebration.

programme.title: Christmas Sweethearts
programme.desc: When a woman returns home to find her ex in a relationship, she enlists her best friend to act as her fake boyfriend.

programme.title: Designing Christmas With You
programme.desc: With her career on the line, a decorator must work with an unexpected partner to showcase a house for an upcoming Christmas gala.

programme.title: Designing Christmas With You
programme.desc: With her career on the line, a decorator must work with an unexpected partner to showcase a house for an upcoming Christmas gala.

programme.title: 12 Games of Christmas
programme.desc: Two old friends and a group of their neighbors are transported into a Christmas-themed board game during a Christmas party.

programme.title: The Spruces and the Pines
programme.desc: The Spruces and the Pines, rival tree farm-owning families, have been feuding for years. When the respective heirs fall in love, they must keep their growing romance a secret, or they'll risk a Christmas blow-up that could destroy everything.

programme.title: A Royal Christmas on Ice
programme.desc: Looking to escape his royal life, a dashing prince comes to the United States to start a business in a small town in upstate New York and winds up falling for a former Olympic ice skater.

programme.title: Aisle Be Home for Christmas
programme.desc: Due to a sudden blizzard, a group of Christmas shoppers and employees, Drew and Michelle included, are stranded in their local big box store. Drew and Michelle realize just how much joy they've been missing out on by not being in each other's lives.

programme.title: Coupled Up for Christmas
programme.desc: Tiffany finally reunites with her longtime crush, Brett, only to find out he has a serious girlfriend. She decides to pair up with a recently heartbroken Peter to win back the affection of their respective soulmates.

programme.title: A Very Curious Christmas
programme.desc: A rising star reporter must uncover the identity of a local late-night bandit who has been stealing beautiful home Christmas displays across the city.

programme.title: Crown Prince of Christmas
programme.desc: Madison jokingly tells her overbearing family that she is dating the prince of a small European nation. The joke goes too far as her friend/co-worker Sebastian is roped into impersonating the prince while visiting her family in New Jersey.

programme.title: A Vintage Christmas
programme.desc: A dedicated preservationist battles a developer's ambitions to tear down a historic Post Office with ties to her family. The choice of old versus new threatens to divide the small town unless there is a solution for the greater good of all concerned.

programme.title: The Art of Christmas
programme.desc: After her latest gallery exhibition literally goes up in flames, struggling artist Liv James accepts a teaching job at a local elementary school to make ends meet.

programme.title: Royally Wrapped for Christmas
programme.desc: Lindsay, the NY director of an international charity organization, is called to the Kingdom of Veronia by the royal family to interview for the job of overseeing the whole operation. During the interview process, she finds true love with the prince.

programme.title: Santa, Maybe
programme.desc: Theater director Lila must rise to the challenge of putting on the perfect Christmas ballet alongside a difficult new colleague, while also discovering her office secret Santa in the process.

programme.title: A Dogwalker's Christmas Tale
programme.desc: A spoiled college student walks a developer's dog and is delighted when she sees he plans to build a salon over a nearby dog park. When she meets a handsome dog walker at the park, she tries to put aside her selfish ways to help him save the park.

programme.desc: Theo continues to miss connecting with his girlfriend, Kim, as he attempts to propose at Christmas.

programme.desc: In an effort to get away from their problems, identical twins Bianca, a single city girl with a Scrooge-like boss, and Kaelynn, a single mother of two, decide to switch places for Christmas.

programme.title: My Favorite Christmas Tree
programme.desc: Kyla visits a small town attempting to find her ancestry and meets a Christmas tree farm owner.

programme.title: A Royal Christmas Tail
programme.desc: A prince swaps a glass slipper for a dog tag in his Christmas search for the woman and her dog who stole his heart during one enchanted holiday encounter.

programme.title: A Royal Christmas Holiday

programme.desc: A woman takes a shot at love after seeing a widowed firefighter and chef on a cooking show. With the help of his daughter, the two of them might find love this Christmas.

programme.desc: A secret baking contest and an unexpected romance teach a duty-bound princess that love may be life's true crowning achievement.
